Each comic book weighs 1/4 pound.
He removes 264 comic books.
Weight reduced by comic books = Number of comic books * Weight per comic book
Weight reduced by comic books = 264 * (1/4) pounds
Weight reduced by comic books = 264 / 4 pounds
Weight reduced by comic books = 66 pounds.

Remaining weight to be reduced = Total weight to be reduced - Weight reduced by comic books

Remaining weight to be reduced = 469 pounds.

Number of toys = Remaining weight to be reduced / Weight per toy

Number of toys = 469 * 2
Number of toys = 938.
